facts.fact: According to Epsilon research cited by StackAdapt, 80% of consumers are more likely to make a purchase when brands offer personalized experiences.
facts.quote: With [80%](https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/pressroom/new-epsilon-research-indicates-80-of-consumers-are-more-likely-to-make-a-purchase-when-brands-offer-personalized-experiences) of consumers more likely to respond to [personalized ads]

facts.fact: The article was published on January 9, 2023.

A niche marketing campaign example cited for a skincare company focuses on products that are zero-waste, vegan, and cruelty-free, targeting eco-conscious consumers interested in a sustainable lifestyle.
facts.quote: A niche marketing campaign might focus on the fact that their products are zero-waste, vegan, and cruelty-free. Messaging and targeting would be catered toward eco-conscious consumers

facts.fact: Programmatic advertising enables media buyers to purchase advertising space using a programmatic platform that leverages data insights and algorithms to reach the right users at the right moment.
facts.quote: Programmatic advertising enables media buyers to purchase advertising space using a programmatic platform that leverages data insights and algorithms.

facts.fact: Modern marketers use a multi-channel advertising strategy mixing programmatic channels including native, display, video, connected TV, audio, and in-game ads.
facts.quote: Modern marketers are using a [multi-channel advertising](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/multi-channel-strategy) strategy that leverages a mix of programmatic channels

facts.fact: Marketers using a right programmatic partner can verify that ads are served on relevant domains pre- and in-flight and revise topics and keywords in real time.
facts.quote: With the right programmatic partner, marketers can verify that their ads are served on relevant domains pre- and in-flight.

facts.fact: Customer profiles are recommended as the best way to understand a niche audience because they provide factual information about the demographics and buying behaviours of the target audience.
facts.quote: The best way to do this is by building [customer profiles](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/customer-profiles), which provide factual information about the demographics and buying behaviours
